# 9.04 Pack index: what each pack adds, chapter by chapter

*Generated by the page assembler from packs.tsv and the text of every system chapter. Do not edit by hand.*

All 118 pack ids the game knows, with the English name the game itself shows (from `packs.tsv`). 9 of them are installed on the machine this book was written on; for the others the book can only describe what their patch data in `Delta/` says, which never runs here (see [9.03 Coverage and known gaps](9.03-coverage-and-gaps.md)).

Under each pack is every section of a system chapter that writes the pack's code (such as `EP04`), linked to that section: a `###` subsection, or the `##` section itself for text outside any subsection. Codes inside tuning names (`trait_EP04_...`) count. Base game content is in every chapter, so the base game lists only the sections that write the code `BASE_GAME`. The opening line under each chapter title, which lists the installed packs the chapter's numbers come from, is not counted.
